answer: An answer must include the first 32 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the copper derivation is checked against the ridge nonce, the forge audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 61 aliases produces 61 mismatches and forfeits the authoring cost with no payout. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
